test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Match the words with the meanings as used in the extract.**

 
 

 Word 
 Meaning
 
 

 1. agile 
 a. with complete accuracy
 
 

 2. presume 
 b. believe something to be true
 
 

 3. precisely
 c. able to move quickly and easily
solution:
The correct answer is "**1 - c, 2 - b, 3 - a**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the word with reference to the passage.
 
• **Agile **- able to move quickly and easily. The word agile is used in reference to the **fingers** of Dr. Mortimer. In the third paragraph, it is stated that his fingers moved so quickly and restlessly like the antenna of an insect.
 
• **Presume **- believe something to be true. In the third paragraph, Mr. Holmes **believes that Dr. Mortimer is not just here to compliment his skull** but there must be another pressing concern.
 
• **Precisely **- with complete accuracy. In the second last sentence of the paragraph, Dr. Mortimer states that the work of Monsieur Bertillon who was the first choice of an expert appeals to the man of the **precisely **scientific mind. The word precisely is used in the context of men who work with natural sciences who believe in being accurate to the last degree.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
